AMENDED 2026-07-28 after CS-003: fix batch size and seed and record both per run. That isolates the same residual arXiv:2601.19934 isolates (batch size 1, seeds fixed, still 0.093 unique-output fraction at temp 0), so our number sits beside a published one on the same mechanism. Seed accepted by LM Studio at /api/v0/chat/completions but does NOT control kernel-level nondeterminism at temp 0 (residual is hardware FP ordering, not sampling). The comparison to published work is on batch-fixed terms; seed recorded per run for provenance but not expected to control the residual. COST CORRECTION 2026-07-28: this was carried as credits-gated. It is not — both runs used local LM Studio models, so there is no API bill; the only cost is machine time. BLOCKED ON CS-013 2026-07-28: fire after resume+load_epoch lands, so a mid-run crash costs one trial rather than 3.5h — and so a resumed run is detectable rather than silently mixing two model loads. REFRAMED 2026-07-29: with independence established and a rep-position effect ruled out, the surviving model is that reps are deterministic replays of accumulated state rather than independent draws. The replicate therefore tests REPLAY DETERMINISM. No prediction is registered — the replay model implies ~0 changed items, and registering that would launder a model into a confirmation. UNBLOCKED 2026-07-29 with a condition: resume shipped at 2c4ac652 but load_epoch did NOT (zero occurrences in mod.rs/main.rs/runs.rs, no migration). Firing anyway under a procedural guard stated in advance — completes-with-no-resume means clean data; any resume must be logged with run_id, resumed-from trial and wall-clock gap at the moment it happens; an unlogged resume makes the run unusable for the across-load question and it must be re-fired.
